objective: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

description: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?
Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
progress: Wares to send on the next ship, <name>?
completion: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.
Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
